'$'''cat <<-'''EVAL_HEREDOC'''
{
 for i in {1..2}, do
 ( recursive_bg 2 ) &
 done
} | tee >(cat >&2) >/dev/null &
EVAL_HEREDOC
' (2,480 us, 0.01%)
'@TRAP (EXIT): echo "EXIT $depth"\, trap "echo NESTED_EXIT $depth" EXIT :: @TRAP (RETURN): echo NESTED_RETURN 1' (29,271 us, 0.16%)
'@TRAP (EXIT): echo "EXIT $depth"\, trap "echo NESTED_EXIT $depth" EXIT :: @TRAP (RETURN): echo NESTED_RETURN 2' (51,752 us, 0.28%)
'@TRAP (USR1): echo "USR1_HANDLER"\, trap "echo USR1_NESTED" USR1 :: @TRAP (RETURN): echo NESTED_RETURN 0' (29,303 us, 0.16%)

'$'''eval "$(cat <<-'''NESTED'''
for ((i=0, i<2, i++)), do
 ( eval "echo NESTED-${depth}-\$i" ) &
done
wait
NESTED
)"' (639 us, 0.00%)
